name: Footprints
description: A snow field that keeps a track of where the pointer has been, pressed into the surface, while falling snow slowly fills it in.

props.name: mode
props.description: What leaves the track: paired boot prints with tread, two parallel ski grooves with pole marks, or a fox's small prints in a line.

props.name: fill
props.description: Seconds until falling snow has filled a track in. Fine detail goes first, then the edges soften and the hollow rises.

props.name: intro
props.description: Leave one track across the field when it first comes into view, which then fills in like any other. Under reduced motion the track appears at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the snow field. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the snow. The pointer leaves tracks anywhere over the component, including over this content.
